decisive_items: right external canal was occluded by polypoid tissue and purulent secretion
response.rationale: R1 is more likely due to the presence of polypoid tissue and purulent secretion in the external canal, which is consistent with cholesteatoma. R2, while possible, is less likely due to the lack of systemic symptoms and multi-system involvement typically seen in Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

rejected.why: C1 is an append-only completion of R2 and does not provide any new information that would change the diagnosis.
